# thrive.md — Your Trusted Health Companion

> thrive.md is the hub of a network of premium .md health domains (anxiety.md, depression.md, ozempic.md, thyroid.md, and more) providing evidence-based medical information, AI-powered answers, and free health assessments. Content cites primary sources (NIH, CDC, peer-reviewed literature) and is written for patients and caregivers.

- [About &amp; Editorial Policy — thrive.md](https://thrive.md/about.html)
- [thrive.md — Your Trusted Health Companion](https://thrive.md/)

## Network

Part of the thrive.md network. Contact via https://thrive.md/contact.html
